values.note: DCNR state forest motorized campsite rate (a state forest program, not a state park one). The $6.50 reservation fee is non-refundable and charged once per booking.

fees.source: ReserveAmerica's price block on every site page of this entry for one night (read 2026-11-10): 'Residents of PA $10.00 Per Night, $70.00 Per Week', 'Non-Residents $15.00 Per Night, $105.00 Per Week', 'Reservation Fees $6.50'. https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/overnight-prices-and-policies ('Motorized roadside, hike-in roadside, equestrian, and rustic campsites can be reserved for a fee of $10.00 a night for Pennsylvania residents and $15.00 a night for non-residents'); Buchanan State Forest Chaneysville Camping Brochure and Map, July 2026 (elibrary.dcnr.pa.gov docId 3767702) ('Camping permits have a $6.50 transaction fee plus $15/night, or $10/night for Pennsylvania residents')

note: A grass opening about 50 m long and 15 m wide at the junction of Robinson Road and Lawhead Trail, somewhat secluded; the agency says it holds one camper trailer. Grass throughout, so expect soft ground after rain. The side road in (about 1.4 miles; mapped by OpenStreetMap as Piney Creek Road, then Lawhead Trail) leaves Clear Ridge Road south of Clearville. Pack out trash. State forest roads are not plowed in winter. --Claude
